name: Phinehas
summary: Aaron's grandson, a priest whose zeal for God stopped a plague in Israel. The LORD promised him and his descendants a lasting priesthood.

key_moments.title: Stops the Plague with His Javelin
key_moments.description: An Israelite brought a Midianite woman into the camp in front of Moses and the weeping people. Phinehas killed them both with a javelin, the plague stopped, and the LORD gave him a covenant of peace.

key_moments.title: Questions the Tribes About Their Altar
key_moments.description: When Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh built a great altar by the Jordan, Israel sent Phinehas to question them in Gilead. Their answer pleased him, and he said the LORD was among them.

key_moments.title: Asks the LORD Whether to Fight
key_moments.description: During Israel's war with Benjamin, Phinehas stood before the ark and asked whether to fight again. The LORD told them to go up, for the next day He would give them victory.
